const faqs = [
 ["timings", "What are the clinic timings?", "We are open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. We are closed on Sundays."],
 ["services", "What services do you offer?", "We offer checkups, cleaning, fillings, root canal treatment and teeth whitening."],
 ["checkup_price", "How much does a checkup cost?", "A routine checkup costs 500 rupees."],
 ["cleaning_price", "How much does teeth cleaning cost?", "Teeth cleaning costs 1,200 rupees."],
 ["whitening_price", "How much does whitening cost?", "Teeth whitening costs 6,000 rupees per session."],
 ["rootcanal_price", "How much does a root canal cost?", "Root canal treatment starts at 5,000 rupees, depending on the tooth."],
 ["filling_price", "How much does a filling cost?", "Fillings start at 800 rupees per tooth."],
 ["insurance", "Do you accept insurance?", "Yes, we accept most major dental insurance plans. Please bring your insurance card to the visit."],
 ["cancellation", "What is the cancellation policy?", "You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 4 hours before your appointment."],
 ["payment", "What payment methods do you accept?", "We accept cash, UPI, debit and credit cards."],
 ["location", "Where is the clinic located?", "BrightSmile Dental Clinic is on the ground floor of City Plaza, near the main market, with parking available."],
 ["first_visit", "What should I bring for my first visit?", "Please bring a photo ID, any previous dental records, and your insurance card if you have one."],
 ["duration", "How long does a visit take?", "A checkup takes about 30 minutes. Whitening takes about 60 minutes."],
 ["emergency", "Do you handle dental emergencies?", "For severe pain, swelling or injury, please visit the clinic directly during working hours so the doctor can see you as soon as possible."],
 ["children", "Do you treat children?", "Yes, we treat patients of all ages, including children."]
];
return faqs.map(f => ({ json: { text: `Q: ${f[1]}\nA: ${f[2]}`, topic: f[0] } }));
